text: Based on the evidence, not the whole property was cleared in 2021. Only about 81.3 hectares, or 2.23% of the 3643.5-hectare asset, experienced tree-cover loss. This loss was primarily in planted forest areas, with 68.1 hectares of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda affected. The loss did not cover the entire property, and the cause of the loss is not specified.
